mentions.name: Nordic Surf Forecast App
mentions.description: This surf app provides wave forecasts for the Nordic countries with finer-grained wave layers than those offered by large forecast groups, enabling better estimation of good waves based on local winds in very complex terrain. No public demo exists yet.
mentions.problem: Wave layers from large forecast groups are too coarse to estimate good waves based on local winds in very complex terrain.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a Surf app for Nordic countries, the wave layers presented by the large forecast groups are too course to estimate good waves based of local winds in very complex terrain. No public demo yet.
